historical_record.description: Engine Company 28 was back in its renewed engine house here by May, when its firemen were the guests at the Telegraph Hill Dwellers' Fire Ball.

O. C. Holt took the $23,940 general contract for a new firehouse for Engine Company No. 28, brick with a pressed-brick front on granite bases, built for four pieces of motor apparatus, with gasoline tanks under the sidewalk and quarters for a battalion chief upstairs.
